messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 20(6)

Article 20 Presumption of conformity of products within the scope of this Regulation. 6. A product within the scope of this Regulation which is in conformity with the common specifications established by implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof, shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III covered by those common specifications or parts thereof.

response.text:
A product within the scope of this Regulation | isPresumedInConformityWith | essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III | product is in conformity with the common specifications, or parts thereof, that cover those requirements | "shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III covered by those common specifications or parts thereof"
A product within the scope of this Regulation | conformsTo | common specifications established by implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof | | "A product within the scope of this Regulation which is in conformity with the common specifications established by implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof"
